claims.text: Hardware plan is a set of computing, storage, network resources SP allocates as target for tenant VM replicas
Comprises CPU and memory limits, storage quota (datastore/volume), number of networks
To tenants a hardware plan appears as a cloud host usable as regular target for replication and failover
Tenants see cloud hosts under VMware Cloud Hosts / Hyper-V Cloud Hosts nodes in Backup Infrastructure view
Hardware plans configurable on VMware vSphere and Hyper-V, standalone hosts or clusters

A.notes: Omits that hardware plans are required to expose cloud hosts and that a tenant can subscribe to multiple plans on different hosts.

claims.text: Hardware plan is a set of resources SP allocates as target for tenant VM replicas
One or more hardware plans whose resources are available to tenants as cloud hosts
Exposes computing, storage, network resources in SP virtualization environment as targets for tenant VM replicas
When subscribed, the hardware plan appears in tenant VBR infrastructure as a cloud host
Hardware plans exposed as cloud hosts on which tenants create VM replicas
Hardware plan has CPU and RAM limits for all VM replicas on the cloud host
Configurable on VMware host or cluster, or Hyper-V host or cluster
VMware and Hyper-V hardware plan options in Replica Resources step of New Tenant wizard

B.notes: Omits that plans are required to expose cloud hosts and multi-plan subscription across hosts.

claims.text: --deleteold option specifies days (1-999) to keep backup when no new restore points, after which backup removed
Default retention policy keeps backup files for 7 days

A.notes: Gives the 7-day short-term retention default instead of the 30-day maintenance default; no mention of the Maintenance setting, prune option, or short-period warning.

claims.text: Maintenance window 'Allow backup server to prune old backups' lets you specify days to keep backup
If no new restore points, backup remains for that period then removed
Default retention for old backups is 30 days
Do not set 1 day or similar short interval, job may remove needed data

B.notes: Omits that Maintenance is only available for Veeam backup repository / Cloud Connect repository destinations.
